== Summary ==
Players Committee D-E1 card image of Boba Fett (Special Edition), shown on [[Boba Fett (Special Edition) (PC 2022 D-E1 card)]]. Source: Holotable image <code>Images-HT/starwars/SpecialEdition-Dark/large/bobafett.gif</code>; high-resolution PNG first committed in swccgpc/holotable commit <code>6c2273e</code> (11 November 2022); card-size GIF in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/11183f97666c2648475db2aa443da4229e3d4b4c swccgpc/holotable commit 11183f9] (12 November 2022). The PC served the image at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/SpecialEdition-Dark/large/bobafett.gif bobafett.gif]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009025705/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/SpecialEdition-Dark/large/bobafett.gif Internet Archive] (9 October 2026; byte-identical to the file shown here, SHA-1 7a8058d1e134dcd1943b11a356fad4f75f08041a).

The same image file is the Players Committee's current Holotable image of the First Anthology card (commits <code>300a323</code> and <code>b21045b</code>, March 2024).

Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
